benchmark_detail.formula: target_dcf_yield = index distribution yield x sector coverage factor

Midstream / Pipelines.note: Distributable cash flow is capitalised at this yield, NOT at the peer free-cash-flow yield: peer FCF is net of total capex while distributable CF is net of maintenance capex only, and mixing the two priced Energy Transfer at 2.3x spot once its audited maintenance capex replaced the D&A stand-in.

refining.basis: owner starting point 2026-09-21: the crack-rule trough (3-2-1 crack +175% above its long-run mean)

betas.note: prior-dominated: the history is too short to overrule it

rules: crack spread +175% above its long-run mean (>25%): forced to the trough multiple 4.50x
derivation.band_rationale: Owner's through-cycle EV/EBITDA band for refining: high cyclicality and terminal transition risk keep it the lowest band here. The market validates it -- the large-cohort through-cycle multiple ran 4.25x-5.54x over 2021-2025 and stood at 5.54x in 2025 against the 5.5x baseline. The low end (4.5x) is the trough the crack-spread rule forces when the 3-2-1 crack runs more than 25% above its long-run mean, so a crack spike is never capitalised.

midstream.basis: owner starting point 2026-09-21: the market's through-cycle multiple (14.14x, 2025, large cohort)

betas.note: regressors collinear (corr -0.91): slopes not identified, prior used; prior-dominated: the history is too short to overrule it

derivation.band_rationale: Re-based by the owner 2026-09-21 on the market's through-cycle multiple, 14.14x (2025, US large cohort, n=10), which had re-rated from 8.08x in 2021 as fee-based infrastructure was repriced. The original 9-12x band sat entirely below the market and would have clamped every proposal to it, so it was superseded. The band is the owner's +/-20% outlier guard around the 14.1x baseline: 11.28x-16.92x.

derivation.band_rationale: Re-based by the owner 2026-09-21 on the market's through-cycle multiple, 5.17x (2025, US large cohort, n=7), which had de-rated from 10.07x in 2021 as commodity chemical spreads compressed. The original 7-9x band sat entirely above the market and was superseded. The band is +/-20% around the 5.2x baseline: 4.16x-6.24x. An equity-accounted chemicals JV is held at book value instead and never reaches this multiple.

_doc: Owner plausibility bands on multiple LEVELS, per (market, profile, field).
They FLAG and never clamp: see check_multiples in valuation_constants.py,
which has no return path carrying a value. Distinct from
regional_comps._BANDS (drops a peer before the median), from
dynamic_multiples.MAX_DEVIATION (caps the engine's quarterly move, and
does clamp by the owner's choice), and from SEGMENT_BASELINES bands.
Market keys match multiples_used.comp_market: US / HKSE / SES.
(*, profile), (*, *). No match is no opinion.
Ranges supplied by the owner 2026-09-21 as SECTOR forward P/E (and
EV/EBITDA for A&D). The sector -> profile mapping below is the
assistant's reading and is the thing to check at each wave's Stage 3
checkpoint; the numbers themselves are the owner's.
Early-stage biotech deliberately carries NO pe band: the owner's note
is that it trades on P/S or rNPV, and HK pre-revenue names are unrated.
Wave 3-5 profiles that do not exist yet (Defense Primes, Commercial
Aerospace & Aftermarket, Defense Tech & Space, and the staples splits)
get their rows when those profiles are authored.
